notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the CMSG_AREATRIGGER report (bare u32 AreaTrigger.dbc id) and SMSG_AREA_TRIGGER_MESSAGE (u32 length + cstring refusal text). MSUI has neither opcode anywhere - not even in Net/Opcodes.cs - so walking into instance portals, quest explore volumes, and inn rested-state triggers can never fire, and server refusal text can never display.
